# What Radarr does at start with an old config.xml, from before the user
# moved into the database: the user and its password in <Username> and
# <Password>, in clear, and no user in the database (setup.sh makes the
# fixture so). A recording of its own; same format as
# ../golden/requests.txt.
#
#   GOLDEN_SETUP=tests/fixtures/radarr/golden-legacy-user/setup.sh \
#       GOLDEN_REQUESTS=tests/fixtures/radarr/golden-legacy-user/requests.txt \
#       GOLDEN_OUT=tests/fixtures/radarr/golden-legacy-user make golden-radarr
#
# The recorder logs in as unarr/fixture before the first request: the
# session requests below answer as they do only if that user exists,
# which only config.xml named. config-after.xml is the data directory's
# config.xml as Radarr left it, copied by hand after the recording.
session-initialize GET /initialize.json
config-host GET /api/v3/config/host
noauth-initialize GET /initialize.json
